prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1457; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Pasadena, Texas, when the car behind me struck the rear of my vehicle. The impact was firm enough to push my car forward a short distance. I felt an immediate stiffening in my neck and a dull ache that spread toward my shoulders over the following hours. I exchanged information with the other driver at the scene and gave the same description of what happened to the officer who responded, to the adjuster, and to my doctor's staff. I have not changed any part of my account. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed. I have been seeking treatment for a neck strain and am following the care plan my physician recommended.
